skill.name: firebase

skill.summary: Build Firebase apps with safer rules, better data models, and cost-aware patterns.

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around related skill names in SKILL.md. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable code in the reviewed file.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 56 uses Markdown backticks to format related skill names, not Ruby or shell execution. SKILL.md contains prose only and no executable script context around that line.

content.value_statement: Firebase apps often fail from weak rules, poor data models, or costly listeners. This skill guides secure Firebase Auth, Firestore, Functions, Storage, Hosting, and emulator workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Functions, Storage, Hosting, Admin SDK, and emulators.
Guides modular SDK imports for smaller bundles.
Advises security rules design from project start.
Supports Firestore data modeling around query patterns.
Highlights anti-patterns like missing rules, client-side admin operations, and broad listeners.
limitations: Does not run Firebase CLI commands or deploy projects.
Does not guarantee security without reviewing real rules and application code.
Does not replace official Firebase documentation for current platform limits.
May require separate verification for current pricing and regional availability.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Firebase App
use_cases.description: Choose Firebase services and design core data flows before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Improve Firestore Security
use_cases.description: Review access patterns and create safer rule strategies for user-owned data.

use_cases.title: Control Firebase Costs
use_cases.description: Find risky listeners, broad reads, and query patterns that can increase bills.

prompt_templates.title: Map Firebase Services
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a Firebase app for [product]. Recommend the Firebase services I need and explain the main tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design Firestore Collections
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Firestore data model for [entities]. Optimize it for these query patterns: [queries].

prompt_templates.title: Review Security Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Firebase access model for [app]. Identify rule risks, missing ownership checks, and safer testing scenarios.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Firebase architecture for security, scalability, cost, and migration risk. Focus on Firestore, Functions, Storage, and Hosting.

output_examples.input: Plan Firebase for a small marketplace app.
output: Use Auth for buyers and sellers with verified email checks.
Model listings for read-heavy browsing, with denormalized seller summaries.
Put payment-sensitive work behind trusted server functions.

output_examples.input: Review my Firestore access plan for team documents.
output: Require membership checks before document reads.
Separate public metadata from private project content.
Test owner, member, and revoked-user cases in the emulator.

output_examples.input: Find cost risks in my Firebase design.

best_practices: Design security rules with the data model, not after launch.
Build Firestore collections around known query patterns.
Use Firebase emulators to test rules and functions before deployment.
anti_patterns: Shipping with permissive or missing security rules.
Running admin operations from client-side application code.
Attaching realtime listeners to large collections without limits.

faq.question: What Firebase services does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Auth, Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Functions, Storage, Hosting, Admin SDK, security rules, and emulators.

faq.question: Can it write complete security rules for me?
faq.answer: It can guide rule design and review access models, but real rules need project-specific testing.

faq.question: Does it help with Firestore data modeling?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on query-driven structure, denormalized data, and common modeling tradeoffs.

faq.question: Can it reduce Firebase costs?
faq.answer: It can identify risky listeners, broad reads, and patterns that may increase usage costs.

faq.question: Is this skill useful with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Claude Code, and Codex for Firebase planning and review workflows.

faq.question: Does it deploy Firebase projects?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, reviews, and planning support, but it does not deploy or run commands.
